scientific_integrity: All real analytic statements are proved by exact periodic autocorrelation identities, Fourier differentiation, number-theoretic divisibility, and transverse Hessian positivity; numerical checks are supplementary and not a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is local at Gaussian chirps for each fixed cyclic length and invertible chirp multiplier. It neither classifies all CAZAC vectors nor settles the global squarefree finiteness conjecture. The stability radius is existential. Originality is subject to possible equivalent prior formulations in complex Hadamard and cyclic-root literature.
title: Arithmetic local rigidity of Gaussian CAZAC sequences
